purpose: Capability a reviewer read in a body and the atom taxonomy has no word for. Recorded as prose on purpose: prose cannot be selected on, so an unmapped need can never be mistaken for a capability the Genome can retrieve or compose.
law: A need here names no atom. The normalizer refuses an entry that matches an existing atom ID, because that is a mapping someone skipped rather than a gap.
A gap stays a gap. It may justify proposing a new atom through normal review; it never becomes one at extraction time.
Keyed by artifact identity, so a need is bound to the exact immutable body a reviewer actually read.
